description: Establish a green baseline for Issue #17 work. Confirm the Node toolchain is reachable and that the existing build, unit tests, and synth all pass before any change, so later regressions are attributable to this feature's work. This is an existing project so a baseline check is required first.
steps: Resolve the Node toolchain: run `which node npm`; if npm is not on PATH, prefix all npm commands with PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" (fallback /root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin).
From repo root /projects/sandbox/kiro-mlb-postseason run `npm run build` and confirm it completes (shared -> backend -> frontend -> infra).
Run `npm test` and confirm all workspace vitest suites pass.
Run `npm run synth` and confirm cdk synth succeeds (deprecation warnings about nodejs20.x runtime are pre-existing and acceptable).

Confirm `npx playwright install chromium -w @mlb/frontend` is available; if the e2e browser is missing, install it once so FEAT-003 e2e can run. Do NOT run cdk deploy or any live AWS/MLB/Bedrock calls.
Record the baseline result (pass/fail per command) in this feature's findings.
acceptance_criteria: `npm test` exits 0 with all suites passing.
Playwright chromium is installed and available for e2e.
findings: Baseline verified by orchestrator this session.
